facts.value: Biometrics appointments are becoming more common for students applying for Pre-Completion, Post-Completion, and STEM OPT since a USCIS policy update was announced on December 12, 2025. Therefore, USCIS may require you to attend an in-person appointment at a local Application Support Center (ASC) after you submit your application. It is important to monitor your case status and mail closely in case you are scheduled for one.

If you receive an ASC Appointment Notice for biometrics (Form I-797C), review it carefully. The notice will include the date, time, and location of your appointment, as well as details about what you may need to prepare.
It is very important that you attend as scheduled, as missing your appointment could lead to the denial of your application.

If you receive an ASC Appointment Notice for biometrics, you can submit a copy through the USCIS Notices Submission eForm in the MyISSC eForm portal so our office can keep it on file and provide any additional guidance, if needed.
